claim: Multitrack non-linear video editor for Linux, GPL 3
Features: 21 tracks, 6 tools, 19 blends, 50+ image filters, 30+ audio filters, G'MIC, text tool, batch encoding
VAAPI and NVENC encoders and custom FFmpeg args
Recommended RAM: 4 GB SD, 8 GB HD, 16 GB 4K; 4 cores for 4K; MLT 7.30
Install via Flathub, OS repository or development repository; distribution versions may be older
Known issue: changing render profile breaks compositor scaling and positioning, no fix planned
Known issue: MKV files from OBS may break the app, no fix planned
Built on Python, MLT and FFmpeg
